🐾 Welcome to my veterinary student life! 🩺🐶

Hi everyone! I’m a veterinary student and aspiring veterinarian sharing my journey through vet school — from studying and practicals to everyday student life, animals, challenges, memories, and everything in between! 🐕🐈🐄🐎

✨ On this channel, you’ll find:
📚 Veterinary study & student life
🩺 Practical and clinical experiences
🐾 Animal-related content
🎥 College & daily-life vlogs
🌱 My journey towards becoming a veterinarian
💭 Motivation, memories & a little bit of fun!

Come along with me as I learn, grow, and chase my dream of becoming a veterinarian. ❤️🐾

Subscribe and join my journey! 🐶🩺✨

📸 Instagram: @nivyeahhhhhh
